summary: Stripe test-mode checkout completion and webhook/onboarding state are proven on staging after fixing the staging User model consent-field mismatch. Human Telegram tap/start proof remains pending, so this is YELLOW rather than GREEN.

initial_webhook_failure.error: TypeError: coach_review_consent is an invalid keyword argument for User
initial_webhook_failure.fix: Added coach_review_consent fields and idempotent migration entries to staging shared.database.User/init_db.

webhook_replay.method: Signed checkout.session.completed replay using the real completed Stripe test session and staging STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

remaining_risks: A real Telegram tester still needs to tap the success-page deep link and send /start so invitation usage and BotInstance creation can be observed.

The first live webhook attempts before the model fix returned 500; after the fix, the same webhook code path was proven with a signed replay. A fresh automatic Stripe webhook from a new completed checkout should be observed before marking GREEN.

Solo checkout currently creates subscription_status=active and invitation, but is_premium remains false by current metadata rules; confirm this is intended for Solo Sanctuary before broad paid traffic.
recommendation: YELLOW: proceed to controlled human Telegram tester for Phase 3 completion proof; do not open broad paid traffic yet.
